headline: Ghana Prepares 2027 Budget Proposal Focused on $10 Billion Economic Plan
summary: Ghanaian authorities are preparing the 2027 Budget Statement and Economic Policy. Key focus areas include measures to ease cost of living, incentives for a 24-hour economy, and a $10 billion economic transformation initiative.
why: Ghana is a major West African economy producing cocoa and gold, navigating fiscal consolidation and structural economic reforms.
